gloss: clamor; noise; din; hustle and bustle

definitions.gloss: clamor; noise; din; hustle and bustle
definitions.explanation: Loud, chaotic noise typically associated with busy places or crowds of people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{喧噪|けんそう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{逃|に}げたい→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧。
examples.english: I want to escape from the noise of the city.

examples.japanese: {喧噪|けんそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れて→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休|やす}んだ→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: I rested in a quiet place away from the hustle and bustle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{喧噪|けんそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}り{回|まわ}っていた→走り回る：04608_hashirimawaru⟧。
examples.english: Children were running around amid the clamor of the festival.

notes:
{喧噪|けんそう} describes loud, chaotic noise, especially in urban or crowded settings.

FORMS:
- {喧|けん} (noisy) + {噪|そう} (clamor, noise)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{喧噪|けんそう}: city noise/bustle
- {喧噪|けんそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れる→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧: to get away from the noise
- {喧噪|けんそう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧: to escape the hustle and bustle
- {喧噪|けんそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧: amid the clamor

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{騒音|そうおん}→騒音：03315_souon⟧: noise (more technical, often unwanted)
- ⟦{静寂|せいじゃく}→静寂：09055_seijaku⟧: silence (opposite)
- ⟦{喧騒|けんそう}→喧騒：16870_kensou⟧: variant writing (same meaning)
